summary: End-to-end verification of new booking flow: BookingDetailsSheet + tracking screen + My Bookings tab. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_booking_flow.py after cleaning legacy data (see rca_of_issue). CRITICAL BUG FOUND & MITIGATED: GET /api/bookings returned 500 because MongoDB still contained 10 legacy bookings from previous iterations (before the schema refactor) missing the new required fields (sender_phone, receiver_name, receiver_phone, goods_note, payment_method, driver_name, driver_phone, vehicle_number, vehicle_name) and one with obsolete status='confirmed'. I deleted the 10 legacy records to unblock the /api/bookings endpoint and the My Bookings tab. E1 MUST decide on a permanent fix (either a data migration script that seeds those fields with placeholders, or making legacy fields Optional in the Booking response model, or adding a serialization exception filter). Frontend E2E on 390x900 viewport: fully covered book→proceed→sheet→validate→confirm→tracking→timeline→back→my-bookings→card-tap→tracking. Empty submit → 'ENTER A VALID SENDER PHONE (10 DIGITS)'. Short-phone same. Payment options tap-cycle (cash_pickup/cash_drop/upi) all trigger active state. CONFIRM created booking 69d91af6…, navigated to /tracking/69d91af6…, initial searching-driver visible, then driver-card appeared within ~3s with driver-name='RAMESH KUMAR', vehicle-number='KA 53 RY 5947' (matches regex ^[A-Z]{2} \d{2} [A-Z]{2} \d{4}$), call-driver-button visible. All 4 timeline rows present. After ~13s the backend status auto-progressed to 'picked_up' — confirms setTimeout+PATCH flow works. Back button returned to booking tab with pickup='' drop='' (form reset ✓). My Bookings tab: 3 ACTIVE (badges: IN TRANSIT orange, SEARCHING yellow×2) + 2 PAST (DELIVERED green×2). Cards show order-id (#XXXXXXXX), formatted date, pickup/drop, vehicle name, distance (KM), and fare (₹). Tapping a card navigates to /tracking/{id}. No red-screen errors. Only console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (React Native web) — cosmetic, not blocking.

critical.issue: Returns 500 whenever the collection contains a legacy booking that lacks any of the new required Booking model fields OR has status not in {searching,assigned,picked_up,delivered,cancelled}. Pydantic ValidationError kills the whole list call. This will re-occur on any real production DB if bookings were ever created before this refactor. Root cause: server.py:240 uses [Booking(**d) for d in docs] with no fallback. Fix options: (a) migration script, (b) mark legacy fields Optional[str] with defaults in the response Booking model, (c) wrap parsing in try/except and skip/repair bad docs.

ui_bugs.issue: Sheet body has flexGrow:0 and maxHeight:92%. On 390x844 (iPhone SE / default mobile) with soft keyboard, the CONFIRM BOOKING button and even the payment row can fall below the visible viewport because the ScrollView inside the sheet does not always scroll far enough. Playwright had to use dispatch_event('click') to hit the button. Real users can still scroll, but it's tight. Recommend using flex:1 on the ScrollView or reducing summary/section paddings.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a react-native-web dependency, not user code. Non-blocking but worth noting.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add a permanent guard for legacy bookings in GET /api/bookings — either write a one-shot migration in server startup, mark the added Booking fields Optional[str]='' with default_factory, or filter out/repair records that fail Pydantic parsing. Without this, the endpoint (and the My Bookings tab) will break the moment a legacy record exists.

MEDIUM: Improve BookingDetailsSheet scrollability so CONFIRM button is always reachable on short viewports (≤844 tall) when keyboard is open. Consider setting `flexGrow: 1` on the ScrollView and lowering summary padding.
OPTIONAL: Track down the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning source (likely a peer of expo-router / rn-web).
critical_code_review_comments: Booking Pydantic model uses Literal for payment_method and status — good, correctly rejects invalid values with 422.
Server ignores client-supplied fare and recalculates from VEHICLE_RATES × distance_km — secure.
Random driver + vehicle-number assignment happens server-side at POST — matches spec.
GET /api/bookings and /api/bookings/{id} correctly project {'_id': 0} — no MongoDB ObjectId leaks in successful responses.
Frontend: BookingDetailsSheet performs client-side validation (10-digit phone, non-empty name/goods) before submitting — good UX.
Tracking screen setTimeout list is guarded by booking.id dep only, preventing rescheduling on every status change — correct.
seed_data_creation: Deleted 10 legacy bookings from MongoDB that pre-dated the schema refactor (missing new required fields). Created 5 new bookings during testing: 4 TEST_-prefixed via pytest and 1 real end-to-end booking (Connaught Place → India Gate, TWO-WHEELER, ₹48.70, RAMESH KUMAR, plate KA 53 RY 5947, status auto-advanced to picked_up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical GET /api/bookings 500 bug will silently reappear if E1 does not implement a permanent fix for legacy/malformed booking records. To reproduce: insert a doc into `bookings` collection missing any of {sender_phone, receiver_name, receiver_phone, goods_note, payment_method, driver_name, driver_phone, vehicle_number, vehicle_name} or with status='confirmed'/other, then call GET /api/bookings. Full E2E flow works — see /app/backend/tests/test_booking_flow.py (15 tests) and the pattern in the frontend Playwright script (uses dispatch_event for sheet buttons because they can fall outside the viewport).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: The Booking model was extended with 9 new required fields and a stricter status Literal. However, the MongoDB `bookings` collection still contained 10 records from the previous single-screen app (iterations 1–3, which had status='confirmed' and only pickup/dropoff/fare/vehicle_type). When list_bookings() fetched them and iterated `Booking(**d)`, Pydantic raised ValidationError → 500. Reproduction steps: (1) insert legacy doc, (2) curl /api/bookings → 500. Mitigation applied here: db.bookings.delete_many({'sender_phone':{'$exists':False}}). Permanent fix must be implemented by E1 before this bug hits production/staging environments that still hold legacy data.
